text: Basic Electronics Co. Ltd (Al-Asasyah Electronics), the Saudi electronics and appliances distributor whose house brand Fisher fronts Al-Fayha's 2026-27 shirt, is a limited liability company owned by its founder Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj; his sons hold its executive posts (president Qasim Al Arfaj, general manager Hamed Al Arfaj and regional directors).
short: Basic Electronics (Fisher) is owned by founder Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj.
